description: Use this when the buyer explicitly asks to cancel an order placed here. The website's rules apply: free while the florist has not confirmed, and for a later-day order until the cut-off before its time window; a paid amount is refunded in full. Two steps: order_ref with confirm=true sends a 6-digit code to the e-mail the order was placed with; order_ref with that code then cancels. It does not modify orders.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the e-mail (second call).

confirm.description: true = the buyer confirmed they want to cancel.

name: pinflower_cancel_order
title: Cancel an order
